checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both palms support behind the raised thigh; separate hands without visible overlap.
checks.feet: Right ankle rests above left knee with flexed foot; right knee opens out while hands support left thigh.
checks.movement: Lie supine, cross one ankle above the opposite knee and flex the crossed foot. Hold behind the uncrossed thigh and gently draw it toward chest, keeping head and pelvis supported.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
